scope: Standalone runtime source feature after v0.6.2; no release published

local.package_inventory_scope: build environment superset, not a complete binary provenance graph

ci.scope: Recorded completed platform snapshots from this run; it also exposed the Windows bootstrap failure retained below. These are not a claim that the whole run passed.

retained_initial_failures: Optional gdbm was built into the first local uv-managed Python. Those diagnostic artifacts are not approved; the builder now requires excludable DBM/readline and inventories native files.
Windows initially selected the wrong Bash path; use the MSYS2 action-provided installation path.
A Windows upstream FFmpeg download timed out; one verified input job now supplies all native jobs.
Windows make required the ffmpeg.exe target rather than ffmpeg.
Git autocrlf changed pinned license hashes on Windows; preserve upstream bytes with attributes and a real checkout regression.
Windows MCP initialized but HTML resource reading failed with a charmap decoding error; explicitly read UTF-8 in MCP and HTTP preview and add two regressions.
The first local source-distribution check included the custom .build-venv from the build sandbox. A separate clean index export, without build environments, passed wheel/sdist/plugin construction.
Windows PowerShell 5.1 bootstrap inherited a host module environment without Get-FileHash; compute SHA256 and extract ZIPs through .NET instead.
On the native PowerShell path, core health/MCP/upgrade checks completed before the initial-bootstrap failure; the run as a whole is not counted as passing.
limits: No phone actions, real device video, Jev calls or model performance comparisons in this package acceptance.
Bootstrap download transport is stubbed locally; a live release download cannot be accepted until native assets are published.
Current MCP processes are not hot-replaced; the next connection uses the promoted version.
Existing runtime directories are retained. A forced process exit can leave a lock that requires operator verification before cleanup.
macOS and Windows packages are unsigned. New-user OS security prompts and OEM USB drivers were not accepted in CI.
Licensing evidence is scoped to current declarations, build configuration and collected notices; not blanket legal certification of every static native dependency.
installation_policy: Agent selects source or optional standalone runtime from the host environment; reuse healthy installs
